assets.caption: Fig. 1400-28 Success of Repair Methods on Leaks on Block Valves at the Richmond Refinery (3rd and 4th QTR Data)
assets.notes: Bar chart comparing Reduction in Valves >500ppm (grey bars) vs Reduction in Average Emission Rate (black bars) across six repair method categories: Adjusted Gland & Injected Soft Packing, Injected Soft Packing (Orbits, WKM's etc), Adjust Packing Gland, Leak Sealed (Furmanite, Koppl), Tightened Flange/fitting, and OTHER (NOT OTHERWISE CODED). Y-axis 0-100%. Legend visible below chart.
